finding.claim: _executeSubCommand registers five process signal listeners on every invocation without removing listeners from previous invocations, so repeated executions accumulate listeners and stale closures over old child processes.
finding.title: Signal listeners leak on each subcommand execution

verifier.reason: The code at command.js:1291-1302 registers anonymous process.on handlers for five signals capturing each new proc, and the close/error handlers at command.js:1306-1343 contain no removeListener cleanup, so repeated _executeSubCommand invocations (possible via the exitCallback path at command.js:1308-1318) accumulate stale handlers.
